verses.original: מַחְלְקוֹתָ֑ם וְלִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯām wə·liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: [These were] the divisions of the descendants of Aaron The sons of Aaron were Nadab Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar

verses.original: נָדָ֤ב וַאֲבִיהוּא֙ וַיָּ֨מָת לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֔ם הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם לֹא־ וּבָנִ֖ים אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃ וַֽיְכַהֲנ֔וּ
verses.transliteration: nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū way·yā·māṯ lip̄·nê ’ă·ḇî·hem hā·yū lā·hem lō- ū·ḇā·nîm ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār way·ḵa·hă·nū
verses.literal: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did and they had . . . no sons so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests

verses.original: אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בְּנֵ֣י וְצָדוֹק֙ מִן־ מִן־ אִיתָמָ֑ר בְּנֵ֣י וַאֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵ֣ם לִפְקֻדָּתָ֖ם בַּעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’el·‘ā·zār bə·nê wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq min- min- ’î·ṯā·mār bə·nê wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ way·ye·ḥā·lə·qêm lip̄·qud·dā·ṯām ba·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām
verses.literal: With the help of Eleazar’s descendant Zadok - and Ithamar’s descendant Ahimelech David divided them according to the offices of their service

verses.original: רַבִּ֞ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים וַיִּמָּצְא֣וּ אֶלְעָזָ֡ר בְֽנֵי־ מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר וַֽיַּחְלְק֑וּם שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר רָאשִׁ֤ים אָבוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֨י לְבֵית־ אֶלְעָזָ֜ר שְׁמוֹנָֽה׃ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם וְלִבְנֵ֧י לְבֵ֥ית אִיתָמָ֛ר
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm lə·rā·šê hag·gə·ḇā·rîm way·yim·mā·ṣə·’ū ’el·‘ā·zār ḇə·nê- min- bə·nê ’î·ṯā·mār way·yaḥ·lə·qūm šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār rā·šîm ’ā·ḇō·wṯ liḇ·nê lə·ḇêṯ- ’el·‘ā·zār šə·mō·w·nāh ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·liḇ·nê lə·ḇêṯ ’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: Since more leaders . . . were found among Eleazar’s descendants than [those] of Ithamar they were divided accordingly [There were] sixteen . . . heads of families from the descendants . . . of Eleazar and eight - from the descendants . . . of Ithamar

verses.original: וַיַּחְלְק֥וּם בְּגוֹרָל֖וֹת אֵ֣לֶּה עִם־ אֵ֑לֶּה כִּי־ הָי֤וּ שָֽׂרֵי־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּבִבְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר׃ס מִבְּנֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·lə·qūm bə·ḡō·w·rā·lō·wṯ ’êl·leh ‘im- ’êl·leh kî- hā·yū śā·rê- qō·ḏeš wə·śā·rê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el·‘ā·zār ū·ḇiḇ·nê ’î·ṯā·mār mib·bə·nê
verses.literal: Thus they were divided by lot . . . . . . . . . for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both Eleazar’s . . . and Ithamar’s descendants

verses.original: הַסּוֹפֵ֜ר מִן־ שְֽׁמַֽעְיָה֩ בֶן־ נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַלֵּוִ֗י וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֡ם לִפְנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ וְצָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וַאֲחִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֶחָ֗ד אָ֣ב בֵּֽית־ אָחֻז֙ לְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְאָחֻ֥ז׀ אָחֻ֖ז לְאִיתָמָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: has·sō·w·p̄êr min- šə·ma‘·yāh ḇen- nə·ṯan·’êl hal·lê·wî way·yiḵ·tə·ḇêm lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ben- ’eḇ·yā·ṯār wə·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim ’e·ḥāḏ ’āḇ bêṯ- ’ā·ḥuz lə·’el·‘ā·zār wə·’ā·ḥuz ’ā·ḥuz lə·’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: The scribe . . . Shemaiah son of Nethanel a Levite recorded [their names] in the presence of the king and of the officers Zadok the priest Ahimelech son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites one family . . . being taken from Eleazar . . . and then one from Ithamar

verses.original: הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ הַגּוֹרָ֤ל וַיֵּצֵ֞א לִיה֣וֹיָרִ֔יב הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃ לִֽידַעְיָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·wn hag·gō·w·rāl way·yê·ṣê lî·hō·w·yā·rîḇ haš·šê·nî lî·ḏa‘·yāh
verses.literal: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib the second to Jedaiah

verses.original: הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לְחָרִם֙ הָרְבִעִֽי׃ לִשְׂעֹרִ֖ים
verses.literal: the third to Harim the fourth to Seorim

verses.original: הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמַלְכִּיָּה֙ הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃ לְמִיָּמִ֖ן
verses.literal: the fifth to Malchijah the sixth to Mijamin

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י לְהַקּוֹץ֙ הַשְּׁמִינִֽי׃ לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה
verses.literal: the seventh to Hakkoz the eighth to Abijah

verses.original: הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י לְיֵשׁ֙וּעַ֙ הָעֲשִׂרִֽי׃ לִשְׁכַנְיָ֖הוּ
verses.literal: the ninth to Jeshua the tenth to Shecaniah

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ר לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ לְיָקִ֖ים
verses.literal: the eleventh . . . to Eliashib the twelfth . . . to Jakim

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְחֻפָּה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ לְיֶֽשֶׁבְאָ֖ב
verses.literal: the thirteenth . . . to Huppah the fourteenth . . . to Jeshebeab

verses.original: חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְבִלְגָּה֙ שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ לְאִמֵּ֖ר
verses.literal: the fifteenth . . . to Bilgah the sixteenth . . . to Immer

verses.original: שִׁבְעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְחֵזִיר֙ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ לְהַפִּצֵּ֖ץ
verses.literal: the seventeenth . . . to Hezir the eighteenth to Happizzez . . .

verses.original: תִּשְׁעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לִֽפְתַחְיָה֙ הָעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ לִֽיחֶזְקֵ֖אל
verses.literal: the nineteenth . . . to Pethahiah the twentieth to Jehezkel

verses.original: אֶחָ֣ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְיָכִין֙ שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ לְגָמ֖וּל
verses.literal: the twenty-first . . . to Jachin the twenty-second . . . to Gamul

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לִדְלָיָ֙הוּ֙ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃פ לְמַֽעַזְיָ֖הוּ
verses.literal: the twenty-third . . . to Delaiah and the twenty-fourth . . . to Maaziah

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֞ם לַעֲבֹדָתָ֗ם לָב֤וֹא לְבֵית־ יְהוָה֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד אֲבִיהֶ֑ם אַהֲרֹ֣ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ צִוָּ֔הוּ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh p̄ə·qud·dā·ṯām la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām lā·ḇō·w lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh kə·miš·pā·ṭām bə·yaḏ ’ă·ḇî·hem ’a·hă·rōn ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ṣiw·wā·hū
verses.literal: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron as the LORD the God of Israel had commanded him

verses.original: הַנּוֹתָרִ֑ים וְלִבְנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י לִבְנֵ֤י עַמְרָם֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל לִבְנֵ֥י שׁוּבָאֵ֖ל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm wə·liḇ·nê lê·wî liḇ·nê ‘am·rām šū·ḇā·’êl liḇ·nê šū·ḇā·’êl yeḥ·də·yā·hū
verses.literal: Now [these were] the rest of the descendants of Levi From the sons of Amram Shubael from the sons of Shubael Jehdeiah

verses.original: לִרְחַבְיָ֑הוּ לִבְנֵ֣י רְחַבְיָ֔הוּ הָרֹ֖אשׁ יִשִּׁיָּֽה׃
verses.literal: As for Rehabiah from his sons . . . The first [was] Isshiah

verses.original: לַיִּצְהָרִ֣י שְׁלֹמ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י שְׁלֹמ֖וֹת יָֽחַת׃
verses.literal: From the Izharites Shelomoth from the sons of Shelomoth Jahath

verses.original: וּבְנָ֖י יְרִיָּ֑הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nāy yə·rî·yā·hū ’ă·mar·yā·hū haš·šê·nî ya·ḥă·zî·’êl haš·šə·lî·šî yə·qam·‘ām hā·rə·ḇî·‘î
verses.literal: From the sons [of Hebron] Jeriah [was the first] Amariah the second Jahaziel the third [and] Jekameam the fourth

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י עֻזִּיאֵל֙ מִיכָ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י מִיכָ֖ה שָׁמוּר׃
verses.literal: [From] the sons of Uzziel Micah from the sons of Micah Shamir

verses.original: אֲחִ֤י מִיכָה֙ יִשִּׁיָּ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.literal: The brother of Micah Isshiah from the sons of Isshiah Zechariah

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲזִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê mə·rā·rî maḥ·lî ū·mū·šî bə·nê ya·‘ă·zî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: The sons of Merari Mahli and Mushi The son of Jaaziah Beno

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְיַֽעֲזִיָּ֣הֽוּ בְנ֔וֹ וְשֹׁ֥הַם וְזַכּ֖וּר וְעִבְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê mə·rā·rî lə·ya·‘ă·zî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw wə·šō·ham wə·zak·kūr wə·‘iḇ·rî
verses.literal: The descendants of Merari from Jaaziah Beno Shoham Zaccur and Ibri

verses.original: לְמַחְלִי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר הָ֥יָה וְלֹא־ ל֖וֹ בָּנִֽים׃
verses.literal: From Mahli Eleazar who had no sons

verses.original: לְקִ֖ישׁ יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃ בְּנֵי־ קִ֥ישׁ
verses.literal: From Kish Jerahmeel the son of Kish

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֔י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֖דֶר וִירִימ֑וֹת אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ לְבֵ֥ית
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê mū·šî maḥ·lî wə·‘ê·ḏer wî·rî·mō·wṯ ’êl·leh bə·nê hal·wî·yim ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem lə·ḇêṯ
verses.literal: And the sons of Mushi Mahli Eder and Jerimoth These were the sons of the Levites according to their families . . .

verses.original: לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀ אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן הֵ֨ם גַם־ וַיַּפִּילוּ֩ גּוֹרָל֜וֹת לִפְנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ דָוִ֤יד וְצָד֣וֹק וַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם אָב֣וֹת הָרֹ֔אשׁ הַקָּטָֽן׃ס אָחִ֥יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת
verses.transliteration: lə·‘um·maṯ ’ă·ḥê·hem bə·nê- ’a·hă·rōn hêm ḡam- way·yap·pî·lū gō·w·rā·lō·wṯ lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ ḏā·wîḏ wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ wə·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim ’ā·ḇō·wṯ hā·rōš haq·qā·ṭān ’ā·ḥîw lə·‘um·maṯ
verses.literal: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok Ahimelech and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites the family heads and their younger brothers alike
